coverageContract.mode: Shared automatic material qualifier, static original source prerequisites only
coverageContract.visualLODDefinition: Source resolution < 10000; highest detail is minimum resolution then index
coverageContract.reception: Unverified: independently captured ambient/direct and live object/render gates are required
coverageContract.textures: Nonempty visual sections with triangles plus WRP terrain texture-table declarations; no proxy or mission traversal
coverageContract.rejectionBuckets: Mutually exclusive first-failure results, not independent lists of every blocker
coverageContract.previewTriangleCounts: Not used; native OriginalMaterialRanges fan counts are authoritative for this report
coverageContract.otherRendering: A strict qualifier rejection is not absence of legacy lighting, RT shadows, alpha traversal, or hand-verified catalog support
